vulnerability_title: DOS in _createVestingStreams(...) due to unbounded loop

content_code_consistency.content_reasoning: _createVestingStreams loops over every address in contributors and calls sablierV2.createWithDurationsLL once per address, and depositEth adds new contributors with no upper limit. Many small contributions can push this loop past the block gas limit.
patterns_found: unbounded loop with one external call per contributor
issues: The finding's snippet shows _createVestingStreams(uint256 totalTokens), while this file has _createVestingStreams() reading the token balance inside; the loop is the same.

scsvs_classification.vulnerability_type: unbounded loop exceeds the block gas limit
